heading: Projects
subheading: Selected work across enterprise and e-commerce applications

projects.name: Mukizh – Apparel Inventory & Billing Web Application
projects.shortDescription: Apparel inventory and billing web application for managing stock, products, sales, billing, and related business workflows.
projects.description: Mukizh is an apparel-focused inventory and billing web application. It streamlines stock management and billing workflows for an apparel business. The project covers full-stack implementation from inventory tracking to bill generation.
responsibilities: Implemented full-stack inventory and billing workflows
Built responsive UI with React.js and TypeScript
Designed REST API endpoints for inventory and billing operations

projects.name: Mukizh Fashion E-Commerce Platform
projects.shortDescription: Full-featured fashion e-commerce platform covering product catalog, customer shopping, cart and order management, payments, and purchase workflow
projects.description: Mukizh Fashion is an e-commerce platform for apparel retail. It covers product catalogue, shopping cart, and order workflows, built as a scalable e-commerce web application with modern full-stack technologies.
responsibilities: Built e-commerce storefront flows with React.js/Next.js
Designed backend APIs and data models for catalogue, cart, and orders

projects.name: EliteHire360 – Recruitment Management System
projects.shortDescription: Recruitment management system handling the hiring workflow end to end.
projects.description: EliteHire360 is a recruitment management system that handles the hiring workflow end to end — from job posting through candidate pipeline management. Built as an enterprise web application with secure authentication and role-based access.
responsibilities: Built recruitment workflow components across the full stack
Implemented secure authentication and role-based access
Optimized API performance for candidate management flows

projects.name: Fraud Identification Executive (FRIDEX)
projects.shortDescription: Fraud identification tool surfaced through an enterprise data platform.
projects.description: FRIDEX (Fraud Identification Executive) is a fraud identification tool. Built as part of an enterprise web platform, it surfaces fraud indicators to decision makers through secure, role-based interfaces.
responsibilities: Built fraud identification interfaces on the frontend
Integrated GraphQL data access via AWS AppSync
Contributed to secure authentication and authorization flows
